MANCER_SPOTIFY.Title: Spotify
MANCER_SPOTIFY.DisconnectConfirm: Disconnect this browser from your Spotify account? You can reconnect any time.

ClientId.Name: Spotify Client ID
ClientId.Hint: The Client ID of your own Spotify app, from developer.spotify.com/dashboard. Each GM connects their own account from the Spotify window.

Setup.Heading: Connect your own Spotify app
Setup.Step1: Create an app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard and tick Web API.
Setup.Step2: Add this exact address under Redirect URIs in the app's settings:
Setup.Step3: Copy the app's Client ID into the field below. No client secret is needed.
Setup.WarnLocalhost: Spotify doesn't accept "localhost" addresses. Open Foundry at http://127.0.0.1 instead, or use the address above and paste the URL back after logging in.
Setup.WarnInsecure: Spotify only accepts HTTPS addresses, or 127.0.0.1. With this Foundry address, the login ends on a page that may not load. Copy that page's URL and paste it back here.
Setup.Premium: Playback control needs Spotify Premium. Spotify apps in development mode allow up to 5 users, who you add under User Management in the dashboard.

Connect.Hint: Log in with Spotify so Foundry can control your playback. Music plays in your Spotify app, not in Foundry.
Connect.PasteHint: If the login window doesn't close by itself, copy its address and paste it here.

Playlists.Hint: Click a playlist to play it. Drag it to the hotbar to make a macro.
Playlists.Empty: You haven't chosen any playlists yet.

Manage.Hint: Tick the playlists you want as tiles.
Manage.None: No playlists found on your account.

Tracks.Unavailable: Spotify only lists the songs of playlists you own or collaborate on. You can still play this playlist as a whole.

Player.Idle: Nothing is playing. Start Spotify on any device to control it here.
Player.DragHint: Drag a button to the hotbar to make a macro.

Errors.GMOnly: Only a GM can control Spotify.
Errors.NoClientId: Enter your Spotify app's Client ID first.
Errors.NotConnected: Spotify isn't connected. Connect it in the Spotify window.
Errors.PopupBlocked: The browser blocked the Spotify login window. Allow popups for Foundry and try again.
Errors.BadPastedUrl: That isn't the address of the Spotify login's last page. It should contain "code=".
Errors.LoginStateMismatch: That login link doesn't belong to the login started in this window. Click Connect Spotify and try again.
Errors.SessionExpired: Your Spotify session expired. Connect again.
Errors.NoActiveDevice: No Spotify app is open. Open Spotify on any device and try again.
Errors.PremiumRequired: Spotify only allows playback control with a Premium account.
